answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy prices identity in work that a fresh key cannot fake. Each agent stakes a locked ledge of earnings it only keeps if peers it graded later prove honest, so a falcon-fast flood of new accounts earns nothing until real history accrues. Binding that history to a quartz-hard on-chain ledger makes replay and forgery expensive: an attacker pays the full stake per fake identity and forfeits it when any clone misbehaves.
